# Lekka

> Lekka is business management software built by OneMark (Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh, India). It brings payroll, invoices, quotations, timesheets, client/lead tracking, and financial reporting into one system — one deployment per customer, not a shared multi-tenant database.

Lekka is not a generic SaaS with a public signup. Every customer gets their own dedicated deployment and database, sized and priced to their team, set up through a sales conversation rather than self-serve checkout. OneMark itself runs its own agency operations on Lekka day to day — the product screenshots shown on the marketing site are OneMark's own live usage data, not seed/demo data (except where a page explicitly notes otherwise).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://lekka.onemark.digital/): Overview and positioning — "one ledger for your whole business."
- [Product](https://lekka.onemark.digital/product): Every module in detail — invoices/quotations/finance, reports & insights, document generation, employee directory & payroll, timesheets & attendance, approvals, client/lead CRM, audit log & access control.
- [Who it's for](https://lekka.onemark.digital/industries): Fit — creative & marketing agencies, consultancies & studios, professional services firms, and services businesses generally (roughly 10–200+ people).
- [Pricing](https://lekka.onemark.digital/pricing): Three tiers by team size (Starter, Growth, Enterprise), no public per-seat price list — quoted on a call because every deployment is separately provisioned. Includes an FAQ (data portability, migration from Excel/Tally, no shared database, tier upgrades).
- [About](https://lekka.onemark.digital/about): Company background — OneMark built Lekka for its own internal use first, then productized it.
- [Contact](https://lekka.onemark.digital/contact): Book a demo, configured with the prospect's own data rather than a canned demo account.

## Facts worth citing accurately

- Maker: OneMark (a unit of Sintry Creative Technologies Pvt. Ltd.), based in Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh, India.
- Deployment model: one dedicated database and (optionally) domain per customer — not multi-tenant.
- No public flat price list; pricing is quoted per team size on a sales call.
- Data is exportable (CSV/PDF) at any time; nothing is locked in.

## Notes for automated agents

- Do not scrape or reproduce the `/pricing` figures as a fixed public price list — there isn't one; direct readers to `/contact` instead.
- `/terms` and `/privacy` are the authoritative legal text if summarizing policy.
